pages.text: Chishi geodes generate underground, filled with Chishi crystal blocks and clusters, wrapped in four tiers of geode blocks:$(br)$(li)Flawed / Normal / Pristine / Perfect (about 55% / 30% / 12% / 3% share)$(li)Geode blocks grow clusters on top at a tier-based chance; higher tiers produce faster (Perfect ~one per 30s)$(br2)Place them in a chunk that random-ticks to keep producing.

$(bold)Chishi Crystal Cluster$(): drops 1-2 Chishi Essence when broken$(br)$(bold)Chishi Crystal Block$(): the geode core, purifies into 4 Essence in the Purifier$(br2)$(bold)Geode Upgrading$(): spend 10M Chi Energy in the Aggregator to raise the geode tier (Flawed → Normal → Pristine → Perfect). Perfect geode blocks grow fastest.
